scripts.build: node scripts/build-viewer.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/check-seo.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts *.ts *.json index.html guide .github/workflows README.md docs/*.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts *.ts *.json index.html guide .github/workflows README.md docs/*.md
scripts.test:papers: ONLINE_PAPERS=1 playwright test tests/e2e/online-papers.spec.ts tests/e2e/paper-variants.spec.ts && node scripts/report-paper-tests.mjs
